snippet.title: A Brat's Journey: A Rose Playing Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Set to release 10/28/25 for rosedoodle's 10 year streaming anniversary.

Play as rosedoodle a bratty catsprout who lives in Stardust City with her found family Buffpup, Shiabun, and AiCandii. Help each of her friends with the help of your trusty mascot pal Beepu while exploring the world of Stardust Valley and find collectibles and do pulls on gacha machines for prizes!

tags will be added later once the game is released

Produced by Evil Hive, a Vchiban fan dev team.
